content:
incident-bot: PAGER: cont-batch-timeout v2 triggered on gpu-prod-3 — sustained token timeouts and KV-cache paging detected (>90th percentile latency spike). Auto-escalating to #incidents.

sam: seeing huge KV eviction rate, paging thrash on nodes serving continuous-batching. 503s are up and p99 token latency jumped to ~2.3s.

maria: any recent config rollouts for continuous batching?

raj: I pushed a change ~15m ago to cb-profiles to bump max_batch_tokens from 512k -> 8M to improve throughput for long prompts in dedupe workloads.

tess: that increase will let very large batches form; if many long sequences align we can blow up the KV cache size and force paging. probably the culprit.

sam: confirmed: KV cache memory graph shows per-shard usage spiking then evictions. paging i/o spiking on /dev/nvme0n1. We have an eviction storm.

leila: copying current profile (from prod):
```yaml
cb_profile: cb-default
max_batch_tokens: 8000000
max_num_seqs: 2048
timeout_ms: 20000
prefix_kv_enabled: true
```

maria: oof. max_batch_tokens at 8M is way too high for our KV cache budget. defaults used to be 512k/1024-ish.

raj: I was trying to reduce small-batch tail overhead for a single customer test. I didn't think about global memory pressure. my bad.

sam: mitigation plan (short term):
1) rollback cb-default profile to safe values (max_batch_tokens=512000, max_num_seqs=1024, timeout_ms=8000).
2) add ingress filter to reject requests with seq_count > 1024 temporarily.
3) scale up gpu-prod-3 pool by +30% capacity while rolling eviction behavior back.
4) monitor KV eviction rate and paging I/O.

deploy-bot: rollback job triggered by @sam: `cfgctl rollback cb-default --to-revision 347` (started)

sam: rolling back now. running: `cfgctl apply --file=/tmp/cb-rollback-2145006789.yaml`

raj: I'm standing by to revert my rollout script and add gating to prevent global profile changes without a canary.

leila: applying ingress rule to throttle inbound sequences:
```bash
kubectl patch configmap ingress-limits -n infra --patch 'data:\n  max_seq_count: "1024"\n  max_tokens_per_request: "600000"'
```

oncall-bot: Note: added temporary rate-limit rule for heavy-seq requests (max_seq_count=1024).

sam: eviction rate declining after rollback commit — down from 18k/s to ~2k/s over last 3m. paging I/O still elevated but dropping. 503s trending down.

maria: customer impact assessment:
- impact window: ~2145006700 - 2145006900 (approx 3.3m peak)
- affected: 2 enterprise tenants reported elevated latencies and retry cascades, one observed ~8% increased errors in ingestion.
- user-visible: increased latency and transient 5xx. no data loss reported.

raj: created internal PR to gate cb-profile changes: PR https://git.redwood/infra/cb-profiles/pulls/455 (requires 2 approvers, auto-canary).

dmitri: I'll take next on-call handoff in 30m. Leaving runbook notes and dashboards:
- dashboards: infra->kv-cache->evictions, infra->paging->iops, svc->contbatch->timeouts
- runbook steps: rollback cb-profile, throttle seq_count, scale pool, alert customers via CSMs if SLA likely impacted.

tess: quick follow-up: we should add telemetry to track max_batch_tokens distribution at request-time (so can detect runaway configs earlier). filing ticket.

sam: final check: current p99 token latency back to baseline ~210ms, 503s at ~0.3% (pre-incident ~0.2%). KV evictions normalized. Marking incident as mitigated but not yet resolved — will keep monitoring for 2h.

maria: scheduling postmortem and customer notes. tagging account team for the two impacted tenants.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Owner: sam. Severity: Sev2.

raj: sorry again for the rollout gap. will follow up with the canary gate and add a preflight check for memory budget.

dmitri: taking over for the 02:00UTC handoff. leaving checklists in PagerDuty.

sam: thanks all. I'll hand over final logs and WALs to the postmortem doc.

deploy-bot: rollback finished successfully across all clusters (logs: /var/logs/cfgctl/2145006789-rollback.log).

oncall-bot: This thread will be used for the postmortem draft. Please add any observation snippets or timelines.

leila: note -> follow-up action items:
- [P1] Add preflight memory budget check to cb-profile deployment.
- [P2] Add canary rollout policy for cb-profile changes.
- [P3] Telemetry: record per-request batch tokens and seq_count distribution.
- [P4] Document recommended safe defaults in runtime docs.

sam: closing active mitigation. continuing watch for 2h, will update thread if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
